explanation: Requested W = 1.2 GeV is below the eta-electroproduction threshold on the proton, W_thr = m_p + m_eta ≈ 0.9383 + 0.5478 ≈ 1.486 GeV. This matches the lower bound of the EtaMAID-2023 hadronic table used by the eta configuration (eta/mpintp.inc: W starts at 1485.6 MeV). At W = 1.2 GeV there is not enough invariant mass in the virtual-photon-proton system to produce a recoil proton plus an eta meson, so the requested point is kinematically forbidden by energy-momentum conservation, independent of Q2, cos(theta*), or phi*. No input file was generated; rerun with W >= ~1.486 GeV (e.g. W = 1.5-2.2 GeV, the tabulated EtaMAID-2023 range) for a physical eta electroproduction radiative-correction calculation.
